dialogues.en: "Whew..."
dialogues.text: "Whew..."

dialogues.jp:
昼休みのチャイムが鳴って講師が消えたところ
で力尽きた。
dialogues.en:
My strength is gone when the teacher leaves, as the bell
rings for lunch recess.
dialogues.text:
My strength is gone when the teacher leaves, as the bell
rings for lunch recess.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「今日の昼はどうするんだ朝倉？」
dialogues.en: "What are you going to do for lunch today, Asakura?"
dialogues.text: "What are you going to do for lunch today, Asakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「食堂か購買でなんか買ってくる……」
dialogues.en: "I'll buy something in the dining hall or at the shop."
dialogues.text: "I'll buy something in the dining hall or at the shop."

dialogues.jp: 机にへばったまま呟く。
dialogues.en: I mumble, feeling wiped out on the desk.
dialogues.text: I mumble, feeling wiped out on the desk.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「俺の手作り弁当があるといったら食べるか？」
dialogues.en:
"If I told you I brought a home-made lunch, would you eat
it?"
dialogues.text:
"If I told you I brought a home-made lunch, would you eat
it?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Nope..."
dialogues.text: "Nope..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「だろうな。ないけどさ」
dialogues.en: "That's what I thought. Anyway, I don't have one."
dialogues.text: "That's what I thought. Anyway, I don't have one."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Geez..."
dialogues.text: "Geez..."

dialogues.jp: かったるい。
dialogues.en: What a pain.
dialogues.text: What a pain.

dialogues.jp:
春休み明けで身体がなまっているとは思ってい
たが、この小春日和の陽気に精神のほうがたる
んでいる。
dialogues.en:
I thought I'd be very tired physically after a spring break,
but actually my mental energy is lower than that because of
the airiness of the hot weather.
dialogues.text:
I thought I'd be very tired physically after a spring break,
but actually my mental energy is lower than that because of
the airiness of the hot weather.

dialogues.jp:
「眠い……腹減った……眠い……寝ながら飯を
　食いたい……」
dialogues.en:
"Sleepy... hungry... sleepy... I wanna eat while lying
down."
dialogues.text:
"Sleepy... hungry... sleepy... I wanna eat while lying
down."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「どっちかを優先しろ……あ」
dialogues.en: "Pick one of them..."
dialogues.text: "Pick one of them..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp:
杉並の呟きに顔を上げると、さくらが教室の中
に走りこんできたところだった。
dialogues.en:
When I lift my head at Suginami's words, Sakura dashes into
the classroom.
dialogues.text:
When I lift my head at Suginami's words, Sakura dashes into
the classroom.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「えへへへ、おに〜ちゃん♪」
dialogues.en: "Teehee, onii~chan!"
dialogues.text: "Teehee, onii~chan!"

dialogues.jp:
スカートをひるがえして、さくらが小首をかし
げた。
dialogues.en: Sakura cocks her head at me, fluttering her skirt.
dialogues.text: Sakura cocks her head at me, fluttering her skirt.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ランチブレイク。一緒にお弁当たべよ♪」
dialogues.en: "It's a lunch break. Let's eat together!"
dialogues.text: "It's a lunch break. Let's eat together!"

dialogues.jp:
授業中の雰囲気なんて｛みじん／微塵｝も残していない、た
だあまくとろけた笑みを浮かべられる。
dialogues.en:
She doesn't have any of the seriousness I saw in the
classroom. All I see is a sweet smile on her face.
dialogues.text:
She doesn't have any of the seriousness I saw in the
classroom. All I see is a sweet smile on her face.

dialogues.en: "Ooohh..."
dialogues.text: "Ooohh..."

dialogues.jp:
やばい。今、一瞬でも可愛いとか思う自分がい
た。
dialogues.en:
Darn it! There was a brief moment there when I thought she's
kind of cute.
dialogues.text:
Darn it! There was a brief moment there when I thought she's
kind of cute.

dialogues.jp: 「……弁当なんてもってないやい」
dialogues.en: "I don't have any lunch."
dialogues.text: "I don't have any lunch."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「拗ねるなよ」
dialogues.en: "Don't pout!"
dialogues.text: "Don't pout!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ボクが作って来たよ〜。ザ・愛妻弁当♪」
dialogues.en: "I made lunch for you, a lunch of my love."
dialogues.text: "I made lunch for you, a lunch of my love."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なに？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 現実的な弁当という言葉に反応してしまう。
dialogues.en: I like the word 'lunch' very much.
dialogues.text: I like the word 'lunch' very much.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「だから屋上に行こうよ〜。日当たりもいいし、
　風も気持ち良いよ〜」
dialogues.en:
"Let's go up to the roof. It'll be sunny and the breeze will
be refreshing up there."
dialogues.text:
"Let's go up to the roof. It'll be sunny and the breeze will
be refreshing up there."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、俺は地下にでも潜るか」
dialogues.en: "Well, I'd better go to the basement."
dialogues.text: "Well, I'd better go to the basement."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「やめろ、そのわけの分からない気の利かせ方
　は……って、いない！？」
dialogues.en:
"Stop that! I know you're trying to play smart, but it's not
working at all."
dialogues.text:
"Stop that! I know you're trying to play smart, but it's not
working at all."

dialogues.jp:
机の下にかがみこんだだけのはずなのに、杉並
の姿は消えていた。
dialogues.en:
I thought Suginami had hidden under the desk, but he's gone
already.
dialogues.text:
I thought Suginami had hidden under the desk, but he's gone
already.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あにゃ〜？」
dialogues.en: "Hmm!"
dialogues.text: "Hmm!"

dialogues.jp:
嫌な予感がして、軽く杉並の椅子の下あたりの
床を叩いてみる。
dialogues.en: Feeling a bad hunch, I tap the floor under his chair.
dialogues.text: Feeling a bad hunch, I tap the floor under his chair.

dialogues.jp: コン……コン……コン……コン……カコン。
dialogues.en: Dm, Dm, Dm, Dm...
dialogues.text: Dm, Dm, Dm, Dm...

dialogues.jp: 「……聞かなかったことにしよう」
dialogues.en: "I think I don't hear anything."
dialogues.text: "I think I don't hear anything."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ピ〜クニック♪　ピ〜クニック♪　突然の雨
　にお兄ちゃんと避難した山小屋で〜♪」
dialogues.en:
"Picnic! Picnic! We sheltered in a mountain lodge, keeping
us from the sudden rain!"
dialogues.text:
"Picnic! Picnic! We sheltered in a mountain lodge, keeping
us from the sudden rain!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「歌うな！」
dialogues.en: "Stop singing!"
dialogues.text: "Stop singing!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ！」
dialogues.en: "Hm!"
dialogues.text: "Hm!"

dialogues.jp:
このままだと、｛・・／迂闊｝な妄想で俺が警察に連れて
行かれそうなので、さくらの首根っこをおさえ
て教室を出ることにした。
dialogues.en:
I decide I should get out of the room, dragging Sakura by
the neck, before cops arrest me by mistake.
dialogues.text:
I decide I should get out of the room, dragging Sakura by
the neck, before cops arrest me by mistake.

dialogues.jp: さて、どこに行くか……。
dialogues.en: So, where should we go?
dialogues.text: So, where should we go?

dialogues.jp: ◆ランチのお誘い◆
dialogues.en: ◆An invitation to lunch◆
dialogues.text: ◆An invitation to lunch◆

dialogues.jp:
春休みボケが続き、かったるいとしか思えない
昼休みに、さくらが一緒にお弁当を食べようと
言う。
dialogues.en:
While I was feeling tired after the spring break, Sakura
asked me to eat lunch together.
dialogues.text:
While I was feeling tired after the spring break, Sakura
asked me to eat lunch together.

dialogues.jp:
そんな、疲れるハイテンションなさくらの首根っ
こをつまみながら、行き先を考える。
dialogues.en:
I grabbed the hyper Sakura by the neck and tried to think
where I should take her.
dialogues.text:
I grabbed the hyper Sakura by the neck and tried to think
where I should take her.
